One register. Every role on the project.

CleanRun IQ gives each person on the job exactly what they need — and nothing that gets in the way.

For Builders

Manage defects across every project without starting from scratch each time.

Set up once, run the same process on every job. From a single home to a full apartment build, defects are captured, assigned and closed the same way — so quality and the handover record stay consistent.

One process across all projects
Open items visible to the whole team
Handover pack ready when you need it
See the builders workflow
For Site teams

Capture items quickly on site with a photo, location and trade — without stopping the walk.

Open the app, photograph the defect, set the location and trade, and move on. Voices notes auto-fill the details. Nothing ends up scribbled on a clipboard or stuck in a camera roll with no context.

Photo-first capture on any phone
Voice notes auto-fill item details
Image markup to pinpoint exactly what needs fixing
See the site teams workflow
For Subcontractors

Receive assigned work, upload the rectification photo and close out without app friction.

No download, no account setup. A link arrives, the trade sees exactly what is assigned to them, does the work, uploads the photo and sends it back. No digging through a full register to find their items.

Works from a browser link — no app
See only the items assigned to your trade
Upload the rectification photo from any phone
See the subcontractors workflow
For Project managers

Track overdue items, trade accountability and handover readiness across the project.

See the full picture without ringing the site team. How many items are open, which trades are overdue, and whether the project is ready to hand over — from the same register the site team works from.

Live status across the full register
Overdue items visible by trade
Handover readiness at a glance
See the project managers workflow
For Handover & DLP

Maintain a clear evidence trail for closeout, disputes and post-completion support.

Every closed item carries its original photo, rectification photo and a timestamp. When a client raises something at handover or months later during the defects liability period, the record is there — no scrambling through old folders.

Photo on every closed item
Full item history with timestamps
Defensible record for DLP and disputes
